---

We have made every effort to make sure the information in this report is accurate as of October 2026. Figures come from the sources listed in the footnotes and bibliography, and named quotes are used with the permission of the people who gave them. The views expressed are the authors\' own, and not necessarily those of the people quoted.

If you think we have got something wrong, please email [mail@ivorwilliams.info](mailto:mail@ivorwilliams.info). We will check it, correct the online version of the report, and note the change in the next version.
